input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is a list of quadrilaterals or a short string written out in the capture tool, so the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: DetectionIoUEvaluator was loaded by file path and executed. The package __init__ pulls in e2e_metric, which needs scipy; loading the one file directly reads exactly what is being frozen and avoids adding a dependency the read-only checkout does not need.

limitations: Detection and recognition only. Table, KIE, and super-resolution metrics score modules this port does not have, three of which have no published ONNX export.
Distributed reduction is absent because there is nothing to reduce across: this port has no distributed evaluation.

Ground truth is axis-aligned quadrilaterals. Upstream accepts any shapely-valid polygon; the Rust intersection is Sutherland-Hodgman and is correct for convex clippers, which is what a detection quadrilateral is.
This fixture pins the metric, not any model's score against it. It makes an accuracy question askable; it does not answer one.
